parent_objective: audit existing M1161 outcome rows for action-divergent and terminal-margin-sensitive wrong histories
blocked_by: M1171 designs an existing-artifact action-divergence audit before new mining or replay
invalidates: new mining before checking existing action-divergent rows
PPO before a broader wrong-history proof surface exists

public_gates: M1172 must audit existing M1161 outcome artifacts only
M1172 must not train actor weights
M1172 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim success-drop proof from action-distance alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: measures whether existing wrong-history outcome rows have enough action divergence and margin sensitivity to support a stronger candidate construction
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: artifact audit only; no mining, replay, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if existing artifacts do not contain enough action-divergent wrong-history rows
stop if action-divergent rows are dominated by one physical pair or target
stop if terminal-margin sensitivity remains too small
fallback_plan: if enough rows exist, design a bounded existing-artifact replay diagnostic
if rows are sparse, design new action-divergent mining
if current-frame substitution dominates, route to observation/intervention audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1171 admits an existing-artifact action-divergence audit

training_stage.stage_objective: measure existing action-divergent wrong-history candidate availability
admission_evidence: M1171 observes wrong_matched_history first action distance is much smaller than reset_hidden
M1161 outcome artifacts already contain action-distance and margin-gap columns
allowed_updates: small tabular summaries derived from existing CSVs
next design manifest if audit is clear
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: candidate availability by threshold is explicit
source diversity by threshold is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1172 only audits candidate strength and cannot claim history necessity by itself.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1172 reads existing M1161 outcome rows only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If existing artifacts lack action-divergent rows, route to new mining instead of lowering proof standards.
allowed_claims: existing-artifact candidate availability for level2 proof-surface construction
no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: Existing M1161 outcome artifacts may contain enough action-divergent and margin-sensitive wrong-history rows to design a stronger candidate replay without new mining.
success_criteria: threshold counts for first_action_distance are reported
threshold counts for action_trajectory_distance_mean are reported
threshold counts for margin_gap are reported
source diversity for promising rows is reported
no mining, replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: mining, replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1172 may only audit existing M1161 outcome artifacts. It cannot run mining, run replay, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, convert rows, or claim proof from action-distance alone.
